evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks through multi-step environment interaction, yet a single erroneous action can alter subsequent states and observations, causing errors to compound over time.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experiments on three long-horizon benchmarks show that RIR consistently improves average task performance across multiple LLM backbones, with structured reflection memory preserving useful experience and selective rollback enabling efficient recovery.
